name: WATNIL Solution 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About WATNIL SOLUTION

WATNIL SOLUTION is a combination of Lactic Acid and Salicylic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Alpha-hydroxy acids and Keratolytics respectively. It is used to manage skin defects such as warts, verrucae, corns and calluses. Warts and verrucae are a type of small unnecessary growths of the skin occurring on fingers, back of hands or soles and are caused by a virus and can spread to other people. Corns and calluses are hard, thick pads of skin caused by pressure and friction that occur on the feet and hands.

Lactic acid and salicylic acid in cases of corns and calluses work by softening the hardened skin growth so that it can be easily removed by using a pumice stone or emery board. It also helps manage warts and verrucae by reducing the infection and its spread to other parts of the body by killing the virus that causes them.

Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you are diabetic or have poor circulation to your hands or feet. WATNIL SOLUTION is not recommended for children under the age of two. The medication is relatively safe for pregnant and breastfeeding women to use. The most common side effect of applying WATNIL SOLUTION is a temporary, slight tingling sensation and tenderness at the application site. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen or last for an extended period.

usesDetails:

Manage skin defects such as warts, verrucae, corns and calluses
mechanismOfAction:
How WATNIL SOLUTION Works

WATNIL SOLUTION contains Lactic Acid and Salicylic Acid that work in cases of corn and calluses by softening the hardened skin growth so that it can be it easily removed with the help of a pumice stone or emery board. This medicine also helps in reducing the infection and spread to other parts of skin by killing the virus that causes warts and verrucae.
usageDetails:
How to use WATNIL SOLUTION

Always use WATNIL SOLUTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply only a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area. Do not apply to surrounding healthy skin, especially on young children’s delicate skin, because this may irritate them. Do not use it near flames or ignition sources (such as burning cigarettes or anything else that might ignite it), as it is inflammable and volatile. Do not apply WATNIL SOLUTION around your eyes, nose and mouth or to broken skin, cuts and grazes. Your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration for you depending on the type and severity of the infection.

Temporary mild tenderness at the application site
Unacceptable discomfort or persistent irritation at the application site

Common

Stop using WATNIL SOLUTION and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Unacceptable discomfort or persistent irritation at the application site

warnings.details: WATNIL SOLUTION must be used with caution in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before using it.
WATNIL SOLUTION must be used with caution in breastfeeding. Consult your doctor before using it.
WATNIL SOLUTION does not affect your ability to drive or use machinery.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while using WATNIL SOLUTION because it might make you experience flushing, sweating, headache and an increase in your heartbeat (tachycardia).
Do not use WATNIL SOLUTION if you are allergic to lactic acid or salicylic acid.

Others

WATNIL SOLUTION is not recommended for use:

On or near your face, armpits, breasts, bottom or genital area
On birthmarks, moles, warts with hairs growing from them or any other spots
If you are diabetic
If you are suffering from poor blood circulation to your hands or feet

Use in Pediatrics:

WATNIL SOLUTION is not recommended for children below 2 years. Consult your doctor before using.

Use in Geriatrics:

WATNIL SOLUTION is considered safe to use in elders. Consult your doctor before using it.

name: Salactin Paint 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About SALACTIN PAINT

Salactin Paint is a collodion wart paint, used for the topical management of common warts, plantar and mosaic warts, corns, and calluses (small rough growths on the skin). It contains salicylic acid and lactic acid as active ingredients that remove the corns and warts effectively and painlessly without scarring the skin.

Salicylic acid has keratolytic properties that causes the breakdown of the keratin layer. Lactic acid enhances the availability of salicylic acid and helps in the breakdown of the skin's surface. On application, Salactin Paint dries and leaves a flexible film over the site of application.

Always apply Salactin Paint as advised by your physician. It is for external use only and not for oral or ophthalmic use. It can be safely used by children, adults and elderly.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of SALACTIN PAINT

Consult your doctor if you notice any unusual side effects while using Salactin Paint.

name: Imiquad 12.5mg Cream 3X0.25gm
introduction:
Introduction About IMIQUAD 12.5MG CREAM

IMIQUAD 12.5MG CREAM contains Imiquimod which belongs to the group of medicines called Immune response modifiers. IMIQUAD 12.5MG CREAM is used to manage actinic keratosis, which is a precancerous condition that occurs as a rough, scaly patch on the skin due to years of sun exposure in affected individuals.

IMIQUAD 12.5MG CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Imiquimod. It is also not recommended for use in patients with an unhealed management site (which is under management with other medicines).

Before applying IMIQUAD 12.5MG CREAM, inform your doctor if you have previously used the same medicine, and/or suffering from autoimmune disorders (disease where body’s own defense system attacks its own cells) or abnormal blood count.

IMIQUAD 12.5MG CREAM should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether the medicine gets secreted through breast milk.

IMIQUAD 12.5MG CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 60 years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of applying IMIQUAD 12.5MG CREAM are itchy skin, pain, burning/ irritation (at the applied site), redness of skin, headache, nausea, muscle/joint pain, and/or tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of IMIQUAD 12.5MG CREAM
Manage actinic keratosis
mechanismOfAction:
How IMIQUAD 12.5MG CREAM Works

IMIQUAD 12.5MG CREAM acts by increasing the activity of body’s immune system which leads to inflammatory cell infiltration and death of diseased tissue thus managing actinic keratosis and its associated symptoms in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use IMIQUAD 12.5MG CREAM

Apply IMIQUAD 12.5MG CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash hands carefully before and after applying it. Do not cover the area with bandages or dressings after you have applied it. Do not shower or bath for the duration for which the medicine should be applied. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Keralin Ointment 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About KERALIN OINTMENT

KERALIN OINTMENT is a combination of Hydrocortisone, Benzoic acid and Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids, Antimicrobials and Keratolytic agents respectively. It is used for hyperkeratotic (thickening of the skin's outer layer) skin lesions like ringworm, chronic dry eczema, cracked heels, warts, and corns, lichenification (thickened, hardened areas of skin), and psoriasis.

During the management, your doctor might regularly examine your skin to avoid any untoward side effects.

Do not smoke or go near naked flames due to the risk of severe burns. KERALIN OINTMENT is not recommended for use in skin conditions like athlete’s foot (tinea pedis), chickenpox (varicella) or shingles (Herpes zoster), cold sores (Herpes simplex), impetigo, ringworm, or thrush, infected lesions, ulcerative conditions, red appearance on the face, peri-oral dermatitis, or acne.

KERALIN OINTMENT is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless specifically directed by your doctor.

KERALIN OINTMENT should be used with caution in children above 2 years of age and in elderly patients.

The most common side effect of using KERALIN OINTMENT is irritation at the application site like burning or itching. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KERALIN OINTMENT

It is used for hyperkeratotic skin lesions such as:

Ringworm
Chronic dry eczema
Cracked heels
Warts and corns
Lichenification
Psoriasis
mechanismOfAction:
How KERALIN OINTMENT Works

KERALIN OINTMENT is a combination of Hydrocortisone, Benzoic acid and Salicylic acid whereas Hydrocortisone is a glucocorticoid that inhibits the synthesis of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that cause inflammatory signs like redness, swelling, and itching. Benzoic acid helps to manage infection caused by bacteria. Salicylic acid reduces the swelling and redness caused by the infection and acts as an antibacterial agent.
usageDetails:
How to use KERALIN OINTMENT

Apply KERALIN OINTMENT as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Dersol 40% Ointment 25gm
introduction:
Introduction About DERSOL 40% OINTMENT

DERSOL 40% OINTMENT contains Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Keratolytic agents. DERSOL 40% OINTMENT is used manage skin conditions such as acne, blemishes (discolored spot-on skin), skin redness, and other skin diseases.

It is also used to manage dandruff, corn & calluses (thickened layers of skin) in affected individuals.

DERSOL 40% OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients allergic to salicylic acid. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active inflammation/dermatitis, infection (at the application site), acute viral infection, skin malignancy, and/or tanned skin.

Before applying DERSOL 40% OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for surgery, and/or suffering from any kidney problems.

DERSOL 40% OINTMENT is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. It is considered to be safe to be used in breastfeeding women. Avoid applying the medicine on skin areas which might come in direct contact with infant’s skin.

DERSOL 40% OINTMENT should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 1-15 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before applying the medicine.

The most common side effects of applying DERSOL 40% OINTMENT are erythema (skin redness), and/or dryness of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

DERSOL 40% OINTMENT works by penetrating the affected area of skin and causing destruction to the bacteria which also reduces oil production in the skin thus managing and managing the occurrence of skin conditions such as acne, blemishes, dandruff, and corn & calluses in affected individuals.

Always apply DERSOL 40% OINTMENT as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before use and work into a lather by adding water. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Salex L Solution 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About SALEX L SOLUTION

SALEX L SOLUTION is a combination of Lactic Acid and Salicylic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Alpha-hydroxy acids and Keratolytics respectively. It is used to manage skin defects such as warts, verrucae, corns and calluses. Warts and verrucae are a type of small unnecessary growths of the skin occurring on fingers, back of hands or soles and are caused by a virus and can spread to other people. Corns and calluses are hard, thick pads of skin caused by pressure and friction that occur on the feet and hands.

Lactic acid and salicylic acid in cases of corns and calluses work by softening the hardened skin growth so that it can be easily removed by using a pumice stone or emery board. It also helps manage warts and verrucae by reducing the infection and its spread to other parts of the body by killing the virus that causes them.

Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you are diabetic or have poor circulation to your hands or feet. SALEX L SOLUTION is not recommended for children under the age of two. The medication is relatively safe for pregnant and breastfeeding women to use. The most common side effect of applying SALEX L SOLUTION is a temporary, slight tingling sensation and tenderness at the application site. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen or last for an extended period.

How SALEX L SOLUTION Works

SALEX L SOLUTION contains Lactic Acid and Salicylic Acid that work in cases of corn and calluses by softening the hardened skin growth so that it can be it easily removed with the help of a pumice stone or emery board. This medicine also helps in reducing the infection and spread to other parts of skin by killing the virus that causes warts and verrucae.
usageDetails:
How to use SALEX L SOLUTION

Always use SALEX L SOLUTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply only a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area. Do not apply to surrounding healthy skin, especially on young children’s delicate skin, because this may irritate them. Do not use it near flames or ignition sources (such as burning cigarettes or anything else that might ignite it), as it is inflammable and volatile. Do not apply SALEX L SOLUTION around your eyes, nose and mouth or to broken skin, cuts and grazes. Your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration for you depending on the type and severity of the infection.

SALEX L SOLUTION must be used with caution in breastfeeding. Consult your doctor before using it.
SALEX L SOLUTION does not affect your ability to drive or use machinery.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while using SALEX L SOLUTION because it might make you experience flushing, sweating, headache and an increase in your heartbeat (tachycardia).
Do not use SALEX L SOLUTION if you are allergic to lactic acid or salicylic acid.

Others

SALEX L SOLUTION is not recommended for use:

On or near your face, armpits, breasts, bottom or genital area
On birthmarks, moles, warts with hairs growing from them or any other spots
If you are diabetic
If you are suffering from poor blood circulation to your hands or feet

Use in Pediatrics:

SALEX L SOLUTION is not recommended for children below 2 years. Consult your doctor before using.

Use in Geriatrics:

SALEX L SOLUTION is considered safe to use in elders. Consult your doctor before using it.

Driving and Using Machines

SALEX L SOLUTION does not affect your ability to drive or use machinery.

Alcohol

Avoid consumption of alcohol while using SALEX L SOLUTION because it might make you experience flushing, sweating, headache and an increase in your heartbeat (tachycardia).

Allergy

Do not use SALEX L SOLUTION if you are allergic to lactic acid or salicylic acid.

Others

SALEX L SOLUTION is not recommended for use:

On or near your face, armpits, breasts, bottom or genital area
On birthmarks, moles, warts with hairs growing from them or any other spots
If you are diabetic
If you are suffering from poor blood circulation to your hands or feet

Use in Pediatrics:

SALEX L SOLUTION is not recommended for children below 2 years. Consult your doctor before using.

Use in Geriatrics:

SALEX L SOLUTION is considered safe to use in elders. Consult your doctor before using it.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

SALEX L SOLUTION is not known to affect or to be affected by any other medicines.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally use too much of SALEX L SOLUTION or if the medicine accidentally gets into the eye or is swallowed, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital.
